page: Microsoft Azure D248ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 server family. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, this instance provides 248 dedicated virtual CPUs and 992.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The underlying virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

A key characteristic of the D248ds_v7 is its substantial local storage capacity, featuring 15118 GB of local disk space. Additionally, the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type.

Given its massive scale of 248 vCPUs and nearly a terabyte of memory, this instance represents a high-density hardware class designed for enterprise-scale workloads. The qualitative cost efficiency is centered on consolidating massive multi-threaded applications and large databases onto a single node, reducing the overhead of distributed systems. Appropriate workloads include large-scale relational databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy web-serving clusters, and data-intensive general-purpose applications that require high local storage capacity and substantial parallel processing power.
description: Microsoft Azure D248ds_v7 is a high-capacity, general-purpose virtual machine from the Ddsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Designed for massive resource consolidation, this instance offers high compute and memory density for enterprise environments. It is well-suited for large-scale databases, heavy web-serving workloads, and data-intensive applications that benefit from substantial local storage and high parallel processing capabilities without the need for dedicated GPU acceleration.
